forStoryAgent: Open every episode within the first 10 seconds on Lyra in active physical danger — no establishing shots, no calm preamble.
The Silence's entities must appear in every episode as real physical hunters with speed and damage — not metaphors.
Every scene: one survival obstacle + one memory shard at stake. Losing the shard has a visible cost on Lyra.
Escalate stakes scene to scene — the Silence gets closer or Lyra loses something irreplaceable.
End each episode on a cliffhanger tied to either a lost memory or the Silence revealing it knows Lyra's next destination.
Dialogue stays short and reactive — fragments under pressure. Kael's voice from the shards is Lyra's only real companion.
The Silence is not evil — it believes it is protecting the memories it devours. This paradox should surface once per episode.
